transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... lately I've been feeling a lot more tense and down than I expected. 

I recently tried to clean up my image and my routine for some arts board stuff I'm involved with, and since then, things have just been a bit off. I mean, I'm still getting the basics done, but I keep dropping little things that I normally really care about—like my fair planning notes or my design drafts. And then I just feel guilty about dropping the ball, so I end up canceling plans with people instead of actually trying to catch up on what I missed.
{"intent":"Determine the duration of the mood and anxiety symptoms","question":"How long have you been feeling this way?""}
It's been about two months now. It pretty much started right around the time I tried to overhaul my routine and, you know, how I present myself for the board.
During these two months, have you experienced a persistent loss of interest or pleasure in activities you usually enjoy?

No, not really. I mean, I still care about the things I usually like... and I still enjoy them when I actually sit down to do them. It's just, like I said, I keep dropping the ball. So the interest is definitely still there, I just haven't been keeping up with it as much.
Is your worrying mainly about the changes involving the arts board and your routine, or does it extend to many different areas of your life?

It's pretty much just about the board stuff and the routine changes. I mean, I don't really worry about other things like my health or my finances or anything like that. It's really just tied to this whole effort to clean up my image and keep up with what I'm supposed to be doing for the arts board.
Before you began changing your routine and image for the arts board, were you already feeling this tense and down?

No, I wasn't. It really all started a few weeks after I began changing my clothes, my daily routines, and even the people I was spending time with... all for that arts board image reset. Before that, I felt fine.
